title: 第455章 就是你了仰望u7第454章 未来的展望
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：赵老驴和杏花村的女人们第一卷：默认第455章就是你了仰望u7（..la）“决定好了吗，买什么类型的车？什么牌子的车？”赵大柱问道。
李慧珍说道：“既然咱家不出远门不跑高速，而且咱们这地方也不算太冷，到了冬天最冷也就零下几度而已，那咱们就买电车好了，纯电的。”
李玉娇立即跟着说道：“既然买纯电车，那肯定得买比亚迪，比亚迪现在是整个新能源汽车行业里的龙头标杆，这个牌子的纯电车肯定不会差！”
“行，我打个电话问问。”
赵大柱乐乐呵呵的说道，然后就掏出手机给桃花县天辉四儿子店的老板王光辉打去电话。
电话很快就打通了，王光辉带着笑意的声音立即从手机里传出：“是你啊赵大爷，你决定买车了吗？什么时候来我的店里看车？”
“我今天刚拿到驾照，准备明天上午去你的四儿子店看车买车。你那里都有什么车啊，比亚迪的纯电车有没有？”赵大柱问道。
王光辉立即就兴冲冲的说道：“赵大爷你想买比亚迪的纯电车是吧？那你找我可算是找对人了，我的四儿子店里最多的就是比亚迪的车，而且基本上都是纯电的！只要你想，仰望U9这样的纯电跑车我都能给你弄来！”
赵大柱被王光辉逗的哈哈大笑起来。
“跑车就算了，那都是中看不中用的玩意儿，实用性太低了。我买个高端一点的家用车就行，车就是交通工具，不能脱离它的本质。”赵大柱笑着说道。
“那我推荐你买仰望U7，不仅好看而且还非常实用，各种先进功能一样不少，加速快续航长，顶级中的顶级！而且仰望U7的价格也很实在，这么好的车居然才卖八十多万，你敢信？”王光辉精神抖擞的说道。
赵大柱对仰望U7确实也有一些了解，毕竟他平日里也经常用手机网上冲浪的，而且最近这段时间他在手机上看的各种汽车的视频比价多，仰望U7确实是纯电车里最为出彩的一款！
于是赵大柱又问：“你那里有仰望U7的实车吗？”
“有啊，肯定有啊，赵大爷你明天过来看看。按规矩，我店里的这辆仰望U7是不允许顾客试驾的，但我可以给赵大爷你开绿灯，你来了以后亲自开车感受一下，考虑好了再做决定。”王光辉笑道。
“行，那我就提前说声谢谢了。”赵大柱十分满意的点头。
“甭跟我客气，我的梅毒都是赵大爷你治好的，换句话说赵大爷你救了我这条狗命呢，区区一辆不到百万的车算个屁啊，赵大爷你说是不是这个理儿。”王光辉开怀大笑。
又客套了一阵子，赵大柱才终于挂断电话。
然后赵大柱就对李玉娇和李慧珍说道：“我已经和桃花县规模最大档次最高的四儿子店——天辉四儿子店的老板王光辉谈好了，明天上午就去他的店里看车。”
“而且王光辉的店里有一台仰望U7的实车，这车你们应该听说过，很给力的！咱们明天去就重点看这辆车，要是没什么问题的话，当场就把它拿下！”
李慧珍和李玉娇也听说过仰望U7的大名，于是两个女人脸上都笑开了花。

“仰望U7好，这个车确实很不错。”
“我也喜欢这个车！”
李慧珍和李玉娇一先一后的说道，母女二人都目光灼灼的看着赵大柱。
“放心，一切顺利的话，明天下午咱们就能开上仰望U7了！”赵大柱眉飞色舞的说道。
时间已经不早了，赵大柱于是就去浴室洗了个澡，然后上楼等李玉娇。
而李玉娇此刻正和李慧珍一起洗澡呢。
母女两个在浴室里有说有笑的洗澡，哗啦啦的水声赵大柱在楼上房间都能清清楚楚的听见，甚至还能听到母女两个银铃似的笑声。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Zhao Laolvv and the Women of Xinghua Village Volume 1: Default Chapter 455 is yours. Looking up to u7 (..la) "Have you decided? What type of car to buy? What brand of car?" Zhao Dazhu asked.
Li Huizhen said: "Since our family doesn't travel far and doesn't travel on highways, and our place isn't too cold. The coldest in winter is only a few degrees below zero, then we should buy a tram, which is purely electric."
Li Yujiao immediately followed up and said: "If you want to buy a pure electric car, you must buy BYD. BYD is now the leading benchmark in the entire new energy vehicle industry, and this brand of pure electric cars will definitely be good!"
"Okay, I'll call and ask."
Zhao Dazhu said cheerfully, and then took out his mobile phone to call Wang Guanghui, the owner of Tianhui Fourth Son Store in Taohua County.
The call was quickly connected, and Wang Guanghui's smiling voice immediately came from the phone: "It's you, Uncle Zhao, have you decided to buy a car? When will you come to my store to look at the car?"
"I just got my driver's license today, and I'm going to go to your Fourth Son store tomorrow morning to look at cars and buy cars. What kind of cars do you have there? Do you have BYD's pure electric cars?" Zhao Dazhu asked.
Wang Guanghui immediately said excitedly: "Uncle Zhao, you want to buy a BYD pure electric car, right? Then you have found the right person to find me. The most popular cars in my fourth son's shop are BYD cars, and they are basically all pure electric! As long as you want, I can get you a pure electric sports car like the U9!"
Zhao Dazhu was amused by Wang Guanghui and burst into laughter.
"Forget about sports cars, they are just fancy but useless gadgets, and their practicality is too low. I just buy a higher-end family car. A car is a means of transportation and cannot be separated from its essence." Zhao Dazhu said with a smile.
"Then I recommend you buy the U7. It is not only beautiful but also very practical. It has a lot of advanced functions, fast acceleration and long battery life. It is the best among the top! And the price of the U7 is also very reasonable. Can you believe that such a good car only sells for more than 800,000 yuan?" Wang Guanghui said energetically.
Zhao Dazhu does have some knowledge about the U7. After all, he often surfs the Internet on his mobile phone, and he has watched many videos of various cars on his mobile phone recently. The U7 is indeed the most outstanding one among pure electric cars!
So Zhao Dazhu asked again: "Do you have a real car that looks up to the U7?"
"Yes, there must be. Uncle Zhao, please come and take a look tomorrow. According to the rules, customers are not allowed to test drive the U7 in my store, but I can give you the green light, Uncle Zhao. When you come, you can drive it and experience it for yourself, and then make a decision after considering it." Wang Guanghui said with a smile.
"Okay, then I'll say thank you in advance." Zhao Dazhu nodded with great satisfaction.
"Don't be polite to me. Uncle Zhao cured my syphilis. In other words, Uncle Zhao, you saved my life. A car worth less than one million is nothing. Uncle Zhao, do you think this is true?" Wang Guanghui laughed heartily.
After being polite for a while, Zhao Dazhu finally hung up the phone.
Then Zhao Dazhu said to Li Yujiao and Li Huizhen: "I have made an agreement with Wang Guanghui, the owner of Tianhui Fourth Son Store, the largest and highest-end Fourth Son Store in Taohua County, and I will go to his store to look at the car tomorrow morning."
"And Wang Guanghui's shop has a real U7 car. You should have heard of this car. It's very impressive! Let's focus on this car when we go there tomorrow. If there are no problems, we will take it down on the spot!"
Li Huizhen and Li Yujiao also heard that they looked up to U7, so the two women had smiles on their faces.
"Look up to the U7, this car is really good."
"I like this car too!"
Li Huizhen and Li Yujiao said one after another, and both mother and daughter looked at Zhao Dazhu with burning eyes.
"putHeart, if everything goes well, we will be able to drive the U7 tomorrow afternoon! "Zhao Dazhu said with joy.
It was getting late, so Zhao Dazhu went to the bathroom to take a shower, and then went upstairs to wait for Li Yujiao.
Li Yujiao was taking a bath with Li Huizhen at the moment.
The mother and daughter were chatting and laughing while taking a shower in the bathroom. Zhao Dazhu could clearly hear the splashing water in the room upstairs, and even heard the silver bell-like laughter of the mother and daughter.
